newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Blue chip rally pushes Czech market higher.
newsitem.headline: Blue chip rally pushes Czech market higher.

text.p: Major Czech shares posted a late rally on the Prague Stock Exchange on Tuesday, pushing the market's main indices higher for the first time in four sessions.
Market heavyweights SPT Telecom, CEZ and and Komercni Banka all gained ground during continuous trading to boost the PX50 index 6.6 points, or 1.35 percent, to 495.6.
The Reuters RPIX index, which measures the PSE's 11 continously-traded equity issues, closed up 15.2 points at 1,025.9.
Overall trading was thin with 420,036 shares changing hands on turnover of 331.8 million crowns. Some 101 issues closed higher on the session, while 82 fell and 46 were unchanged.
Despite the gain, dealers were pessimistic that bearish sentiment plaguing the PSE was wasing.
"The fundamentals of the market have worsened and the effects of high interest rates will probably hit the bottom line of many companies," said Jan Sykora of Wood and Company.
Electrical utility Elektrarny Opatovice led net gainers on the PX50, rising 150 crowns to 4,400. Most other utilities were mixed.
